parameters.query:
SELECT
  r.uniqueref            AS read_ref,
  r.sample_id,
  r.reads,
  r.r1_path,
  r.r2_path,
  r.kit_ref,
  k.name                 AS kit_name,
  k.producer             AS kit_producer,
  k.required_se_reads,
  r.requesting_caresite_ref,
  cs_req.care_site_name  AS requester_name,
  cs_req.care_site_source_value AS requester_short_name,
  r.performing_caresite_ref,
  cs_perf.care_site_name AS performing_name,
  idx.i7_code,
  idx.i5_code,
  idx_kit.name           AS index_kit_name,
  rec.recipe_ref,
  rec.pipeline_id,
  rec.account_id,
  rec.recipe_count,
  rec.recipe_options,
  ru.run_id              AS run_id
FROM reads r
LEFT JOIN kits k
  ON k.uniqueref = r.kit_ref
LEFT JOIN care_site cs_req
  ON cs_req.uniqueref = r.requesting_caresite_ref
LEFT JOIN care_site cs_perf
  ON cs_perf.uniqueref = r.performing_caresite_ref
LEFT JOIN indices idx
  ON idx.uniqueref = r.index_ref
LEFT JOIN kits idx_kit
  ON idx_kit.uniqueref = idx.kit_ref
LEFT JOIN conversions cv
  ON cv.uniqueref = r.conversion_ref
LEFT JOIN runs ru
  ON ru.uniqueref = cv.run_ref
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)                              AS recipe_count,
    MIN(dor.uniqueref)                    AS recipe_ref,
    MIN(dor.pipeline_id)                  AS pipeline_id,
    MIN(dor.account_id)                   AS account_id,
    json_agg(json_build_object(
      'recipe_ref',    dor.uniqueref,
      'pipeline_id',   dor.pipeline_id,
      'pipeline_name', dor.pipeline_name
    ) ORDER BY dor.uniqueref)             AS recipe_options
  FROM data_operation_recipes dor
  WHERE dor.kit_ref                  = r.kit_ref
    AND dor.requesting_caresite_ref  = r.requesting_caresite_ref
    AND dor.performing_caresite_ref  = r.performing_caresite_ref
    AND dor.platform_concept_ref     IN (11, 12, 109, 398)
) rec ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN data_operations dop
  ON dop.read_ref = r.uniqueref
WHERE r.conversion_ref = {{ $json.conversion_ref }}
  AND dop.uniqueref IS NULL
ORDER BY r.sample_id;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  r.uniqueref            AS read_ref,
  r.sample_id,
  r.reads,
  r.r1_path,
  r.r2_path,
  r.kit_ref,
  k.name                 AS kit_name,
  k.producer             AS kit_producer,
  k.required_se_reads,
  r.requesting_caresite_ref,
  cs_req.care_site_name  AS requester_name,
  cs_req.care_site_source_value AS requester_short_name,
  r.performing_caresite_ref,
  cs_perf.care_site_name AS performing_name,
  idx.i7_code,
  idx.i5_code,
  idx_kit.name           AS index_kit_name,
  rec.recipe_ref,
  rec.pipeline_id,
  rec.account_id,
  rec.recipe_count,
  rec.recipe_options,
  cred.cred_ref,
  cred.cred_has_password,
  NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
    CASE WHEN rec.account_id IS NULL OR rec.account_id = '' THEN 'recipe.account_id eksik' END,
    CASE WHEN rec.pipeline_id IS NULL OR rec.pipeline_id = '' THEN 'recipe.pipeline_id eksik' END,
    CASE WHEN cred.cred_ref IS NULL THEN 'account_id ile eslesen Archer credential yok' END,
    CASE WHEN cred.cred_ref IS NOT NULL AND NOT cred.cred_has_password THEN 'Archer credential sifresi eksik' END
  ), '') AS archer_config_error,
  ru.run_id              AS run_id
FROM reads r
LEFT JOIN kits k
  ON k.uniqueref = r.kit_ref
LEFT JOIN care_site cs_req
  ON cs_req.uniqueref = r.requesting_caresite_ref
LEFT JOIN care_site cs_perf
  ON cs_perf.uniqueref = r.performing_caresite_ref
LEFT JOIN indices idx
  ON idx.uniqueref = r.index_ref
LEFT JOIN kits idx_kit
  ON idx_kit.uniqueref = idx.kit_ref
LEFT JOIN conversions cv
  ON cv.uniqueref = r.conversion_ref
LEFT JOIN runs ru
  ON ru.uniqueref = cv.run_ref
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)                              AS recipe_count,
    MIN(dor.uniqueref)                    AS recipe_ref,
    MIN(dor.pipeline_id)                  AS pipeline_id,
    MIN(dor.account_id)                   AS account_id,
    json_agg(json_build_object(
      'recipe_ref',    dor.uniqueref,
      'pipeline_id',   dor.pipeline_id,
      'pipeline_name', dor.pipeline_name
    ) ORDER BY dor.uniqueref)             AS recipe_options
  FROM data_operation_recipes dor
  WHERE dor.kit_ref                  = r.kit_ref
    AND dor.requesting_caresite_ref  = r.requesting_caresite_ref
    AND dor.performing_caresite_ref  = r.performing_caresite_ref
    AND dor.platform_concept_ref     IN (11, 12, 109, 398)
) rec ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    csc.uniqueref AS cred_ref,
    (csc.platform_site_password IS NOT NULL AND csc.platform_site_password <> '') AS cred_has_password
  FROM care_site_credentials csc
  WHERE csc.platform_concept_ref = 12
    AND csc.platform_site_id     = rec.account_id
  ORDER BY (csc.platform_site_password IS NOT NULL AND csc.platform_site_password <> '') DESC, csc.is_active DESC, csc.uniqueref
  LIMIT 1
) cred ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN data_operations dop
  ON dop.read_ref = r.uniqueref
WHERE r.conversion_ref = {{ $json.conversion_ref }}
  AND dop.uniqueref IS NULL
ORDER BY r.sample_id;
